title: Milton Larkin watches over him and helps him buy a car
summary: Larkin promised Cobb's mother to look after him, shared a house, cooked, lent $35 and showed him how to pay the car note from road trips.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, Milt Larkin told us that he had to promise your mother that he would watch over you.

Didn't I just finish telling you every leader that got me as a teenager had to promise my mother everything -- and that was a ritual with her. But we made it --and he did, and Milton did look out after for me. I can go to

the strengths that Milton and I lived together and we shared a house together, and he cooked, saw that and I ate, and when I bought my first car, Milton taught me how to handle it, and he wanted me to have it because we were close together.

He went in to his money belt and got $35 out to give me the down payment, and then when I got the car, he told me how I could pay for it, because on a road trip we'd get $10 apiece for the car plus gas and oil. And my car note wasn't but $26 a month, and if we made 2 jobs a month out of town, that was $20, and then when we worked in town, then you could take -- if you couldn't put $6 with that, then you were in trouble.
